ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity (light gray/white) pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface; low intensity (black) pixels are concentrated in a thick central vertical axis and along the trailing edge boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white/light-gray blobs occupy the interior of both fluke lobes. A high-contrast black band extends from the median notch down to the peduncle. Black pigmentation follows the 2D perimeter of the trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude sawtooth serrations extending across the entire trailing edge; peaks are most pronounced on the outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a generally linear trajectory from the distal tips to the median notch, with a slight overall convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several localized, high-intensity circular pixel clusters (approx. 6-8) are visible on the medial-lower section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged pixel loss and erosion at the distal tips of both lobes, indicating physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: The central black pigmentation band exhibits a distinctive 'hourglass' constriction near the center of the vertical axis.
